lines.line: This chair will last ten years.
lines.adds_information: A photoreal chair makes the claim about years concrete: leather and oak you can almost touch.

lines.line: Oak frame, leather seat, and not a screw in sight.
lines.adds_information: An orbit shows the joints and the seat from the side, which the words only list.

lines.line: Every pixel here is path traced, in code.
lines.adds_information: The cost of one frame as a number answers how expensive photoreal in code is.

lines.line: Same chair. Any lens. Any light.
lines.adds_information: A close glass-and-light shot proves the same set can be shot from any lens.
